name: ContextFold
description: Topic-aware context folding for OpenClaw agents — detect topics, fold losslessly, unfold on demand

maxTokens.description: Maximum token budget for context window (default: 128000)

summaryModel.description: Model to use for context summarization (defaults to current agent model)

autoSummarize.description: Automatically summarize when context exceeds threshold (default: true)

summarizeThreshold.description: Token percentage threshold to trigger auto-summarization (0-1, default: 0.8)

preserveSystemMessages.description: Always preserve system messages during pruning (default: true)

preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of recent messages to always keep (default: 10)

maxTokens.label: Max Context Tokens
maxTokens.help: Maximum token budget for the context window

summaryModel.label: Summary Model
summaryModel.placeholder: Leave empty to use current model
summaryModel.help: Model ID for generating context summaries

autoSummarize.label: Auto Summarize
autoSummarize.help: Automatically summarize old messages when context grows too large

summarizeThreshold.label: Summarize Threshold
summarizeThreshold.help: Trigger summarization when context reaches this fraction of max tokens

preserveRecentMessages.label: Preserve Recent Messages
preserveRecentMessages.help: Always keep the N most recent messages intact
